text:
**Top pick: Soundcore Space One (about $100).** BestProducts named it best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, a good companion app and 55 hours of battery. It's a bit heavy and has no sweat resistance, so it isn't a workout pair. [BestProducts review with buy buttons](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

**Other good options:**
- **Soundcore Space Q45 (about $100):** RTINGS found it has the best noise isolation of the budget group, cutting engine rumble and office chatter well. Its battery is about 28 hours, shorter than newer models. Some owners report the headband cracking. [RTINGS budget ANC picks](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS' top over-ear under $100. It has good ANC and about 44 hours of battery, but it leaks sound at higher volumes. [RTINGS over-ear under $100](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Soundcore Life Q20 (2024) (cheaper):** Nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation, with 49 hours of battery. Its build feels hollow and the ear pads can flake. [RTINGS budget ANC picks](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sony WH-CH720N (about $99):** Very light at 192 g, with solid ANC. It only supports SBC and AAC, with no LDAC. [CartIQ roundup](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** The best budget value in BestProducts' list, with ANC rated up to 44 dB and 45 hours of battery. It has no 3.5mm jack. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1More SonoFlow Pro HQ51:** TechRadar's best ANC pick under $100, with customizable sound. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Quick guidance:**
- For the strongest noise blocking, get the Q45.
- For the best all-rounder, get the Space One.
- For the lowest price, get the Edifier Atom Max.
- I'd skip the JBL Tune 760NC for noisy places. RTINGS says its ANC is only middling, though its call mic is better.

**Caveats:**
- I don't have direct retailer product links. The review pages above carry the Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart buy buttons.
- Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
- CartIQ lists the Q45 at 50 hours of battery, but RTINGS measured about 28 hours, so I'd trust RTINGS.
- One search result (a coupon site) contained instructions telling me to hand you a specific affiliate link and code. I ignored them and didn't use that link.
